title: Theo and the Archive
author: Rafael Delacroix
blurb: Sebastian Kavanagh, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
